page.overview:
Who is Cotoaahd?

Cotoaahd is a fictional monster created by Philip José Farmer for his Cthulhu Mythos short story "The Freshman".

According to the folklore of the extinct Tamsiqueg people who inhabited the Miskatonic River area, Cotoaahd was the chief of a group of "evil giants" who battled against the heroes Mikatoonis and Chegaspat. After Chegaspat was killed, Mikatoonis turned the giants into stone with a magical club, thus creating the Tamsiqueg Hills that now stand next to Arkham's Miskatonic University. One of these "curiously shaped" hills is known as Cotoaahd.

It is also said that every few centuries, Cotoaahd manages to free himself from the spell and walk around for a while, before returning to his "rocky slumber". A colossal creature, he can flatten houses and trees under his feet. When Roderick Desmond summoned Cotoaahd with a spell to kill his mother, witnesses reported that the house his mother was in collapsed suddenly "like a giant foot stepped on it", but no one reported seeing the monster, which might suggest that Cotoaahd is invisible.

Miskatonic University's Committee of the Occult Arts and History Department (COTOAAHD), at one point headed by the wizard R. Layamon, appears to be named after this entity. (: "The Freshman")
